evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/A/n extends com.apple.eawt.FullScreenAdapter, owns one java.awt.Frame and registers itself through FullScreenUtilities.addFullScreenListenerTo(Frame, listener).
On fullscreen enter it logs the transition and sets Frame.MAXIMIZED_BOTH; on fullscreen exit it logs the transition and restores Frame.NORMAL.

Historical RuneLite-derived source contains class OSXFullScreenAdapter with the same superclass, frame field, addFullScreenListenerTo helper, identical enter/exit log strings and identical extended-state transitions.
Canonical class ordering places rs/A/n at CLIENT_CLASS_000017 immediately before R82 rs/A/o -> CLIENT_CLASS_000018 MacOSWindowUtil.
